verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִי֮ בְּב֤וֹא׀ לְשָׁ֫א֥וּל וַיַּגֵּ֪ד וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑וֹ דָ֝וִ֗ד בָּ֥א אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ׃ מַה־ תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭רָעָה הַגִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ dō·w·’êḡ hā·’ă·ḏō·mî bə·ḇō·w lə·šā·’ūl way·yag·gêḏ way·yō·mer lōw ḏā·wiḏ bā ’el- bêṯ ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ mah- tiṯ·hal·lêl bə·rā·‘āh hag·gib·bō·wr ḥe·seḏ ’êl kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Maskil of David After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him David has gone to the house of Ahimelech Why do you boast of evil O mighty man The loving devotion of God [endures] all day long

verses.original: לְשׁוֹנֶ֑ךָ תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב הַ֭וּוֹת מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ כְּתַ֥עַר עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šō·w·ne·ḵā taḥ·šōḇ haw·wō·wṯ mə·luṭ·ṭāš kə·ṯa·‘ar ‘ō·śêh rə·mî·yāh
verses.literal: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor O worker of deceit

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִטּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר׀ מִדַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·haḇ·tā rā‘ miṭ·ṭō·wḇ še·qer mid·dab·bêr ṣe·ḏeq se·lāh
verses.literal: You love evil more than good falsehood more than speaking truth Selah

verses.original: אָהַ֥בְתָּ כָֽל־ דִּבְרֵי־ בָ֗לַע מִרְמָֽה׃ לְשׁ֣וֹן
verses.literal: You love every word that devours O deceitful tongue

verses.original: גַּם־ אֵל֮ יִתָּצְךָ֪ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵֽׁרֶשְׁךָ֨ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’êl yit·tā·ṣə·ḵā lā·ne·ṣaḥ yaḥ·tə·ḵā wə·yis·sā·ḥă·ḵā mê·’ō·hel wə·šê·reš·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm se·lāh
verses.literal: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin He will snatch you up and tear you away from [your] tent He will uproot you from the land of the living Selah
The righteous will see and fear vvv they will mock [the evildoer], saying

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַגֶּ֗בֶר לֹ֤א יָשִׂ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָֽע֫וּזּ֥וֹ וַ֭יִּבְטַח בְּרֹ֣ב עָשְׁר֑וֹ יָ֝עֹ֗ז בְּהַוָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hag·ge·ḇer lō yā·śîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm mā·‘ūz·zōw way·yiḇ·ṭaḥ bə·rōḇ ‘ā·šə·rōw yā·‘ōz bə·haw·wā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Look at the man who did not make God his refuge but trusted in the abundance of his wealth [and] strengthened himself by destruction

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ כְּזַ֣יִת רַ֭עֲנָן בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּטַ֥חְתִּי בְחֶֽסֶד־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî kə·za·yiṯ ra·‘ă·nān bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·ṭaḥ·tî ḇə·ḥe·seḏ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֣ לְ֭עוֹלָם כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַאֲקַוֶּ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֥ כִֽי־ ט֝֗וֹב נֶ֣גֶד חֲסִידֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wḏ·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām kî ‘ā·śî·ṯā wa·’ă·qaw·weh šim·ḵā ḵî- ṭō·wḇ ne·ḡeḏ ḥă·sî·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will praise You forever because You have done it I will wait on Your name for it is good in the presence of Your saints
